verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents two public REST APIs: the SQL API for running queries and managing deployments (users, roles, tables), and the REST APIs for programmatic resource management. Both are backed by official OpenAPI specifications and Postman collections in the snowflakedb GitHub repo. The probe's 404s at guessed docs-domain OpenAPI paths do not contradict this, since the specs are published on GitHub instead. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product end-to-end through these APIs.
